name: seam
description: Review by intent, not by file. Seam decomposes a diff — or a codebase intent — into seams (units of one intent) and paints them natively: seam colours on the diff, a seam tree, and intent footprints (anchor → spine → culmination) across the repo. Engine bundled (TypeScript), no checkout needed.

commands.title: Seam: Analyze module (all exports of this file)
Seam: Auto-map intent (grow the footprint toward a question)…
Seam: Toggle chain view (symbol links + nature)

seam.toolPath.description: Dev only. Absolute path to a code-review-sort checkout (containing the ts/ engine), run under `bun`. Leave EMPTY to use the engine bundled inside the extension (no checkout, no bun needed).

enumDescriptions: Fully deterministic, offline — no LLM, zero setup (structural cluster labels instead of product-intent prose). Use this if you have no `claude` CLI.
Default. LLM clustering (product-intent labels) + deterministic roles & wiring, fed AST facts from the editor's language server. Needs a `claude` CLI (e.g. the Claude Code extension) on the machine.
All passes by the LLM. Needs a `claude` CLI.
seam.engine.description: How to decompose a diff: 'hybrid' (the default — LLM clusters + product-intent labels, with deterministic roles/wiring), 'det' (fully offline, no LLM, zero setup — structural labels), or 'llm' (all LLM). The LLM passes run on the backend set by 'seam.llmBackend'. Roles (core/link/environment/test/noise) are always deterministic except in 'llm'.

enumDescriptions: Default. Serve LLM passes via a `claude`/`copilot` CLI the engine locates (the Claude Code extension's bundled binary, `claude`/`copilot` on PATH, or CLAUDE_BIN/COPILOT_BIN).

Borrow a chat model through VS Code's Language Model API (e.g. GitHub Copilot) — no CLI install and no API key. Picks the largest-context model available; very large diffs may exceed its window (it will tell you to narrow the range or switch to 'cli').
seam.llmBackend.description: How LLM passes (in 'hybrid'/'llm') are served: 'cli' (a claude/copilot CLI) or 'copilot' (borrow a model via VS Code's Language Model API — no install). Ignored when seam.engine is 'det'.

seam.codebaseDepth.description: Codebase mode (Analyze from anchor): how many call-graph hops to resolve outward from the anchor. Higher = more context but slower / larger (the anchor-bounded BFS depth).

seam.bidirectional.description: Codebase mode (single-symbol anchor): include the anchor's DEPENDENCIES (the 'how it works' mechanism), not just its consumers. Lets Seam distinguish a cross-cutting POLICY (a mechanism enforced at N sites — rendered as Mechanism + a collapsed enforcement surface) from a FLOW (a pipeline with a spine). Experimental.

enumDescriptions: Default. Deterministic floor only (relative + package + tsconfig paths). Offline, instant, no toolchain.
A real language server (go-to-definition). Cross-language, needs the toolchain AND a code-review-sort checkout (LSP daemon is not bundled).
LSP with deterministic fallback — the warm daemon is reused across reviews. Needs a checkout (see 'lsp').
seam.resolver.description: How a diff review resolves references against the repo (for blast radius). 'det' (offline floor — the default), 'lsp' (server only) or 'auto' (LSP + floor fallback). Note: 'lsp'/'auto' require the dev checkout via seam.toolPath; the bundled extension is offline-only.

seam.blastRadius.description: Diff review: show each changed symbol's blast radius — who OUTSIDE the diff imports it (resolved/suggested) — so the change is read in the context of the real codebase.

enumDescriptions: Start with a big cluster's sub-groups COLLAPSED — review the few groups first, expand the one you want.
Start with sub-groups EXPANDED — go straight to the seams.
seam.defaultAltitude.description: Diff review: the starting altitude when a large cluster is split into structural sub-groups. 'overview' (collapsed) or 'seams' (expanded). Expand/collapse a group any time to zoom in/out.

seam.demoSeamsFile.description: Optional absolute path to a pre-built --emit-seams JSON. When set, 'Seam: Load seams from file' renders it directly (no engine run); leave empty to be prompted.

scripts.build: bun run compile && bun run build:engine
